test: CTT-2R: ACCEPT-2 (three-copy vote, read back everything, session cap) on the c45 weights; no training
approval: owner pinned bytes 'CTT RULE TEST at 1.50 USD' (OWNER_APPROVALS_20261018.md, 2026-10-19 night) + the sealed zip sha256, quoted by program in APPROVAL_RECORD_CTT2R.json

attempts.plumbing_retry_rule: only if no part was scored (the run stopped in refusals, overlay, preflight, C2 inits or before DECISIONS_CTT2R.json was written, for a plumbing reason); same zip, same carriers, same settings; any package change is a reseal and needs a new owner word
attempts.anti_tuning: no rerun with another rule, threshold, seed or exam to coax a pass; a miss is a result

host.instance: g5.xlarge (1 x NVIDIA A10G 24 GB, 4 vCPU, 16 GiB RAM): the design's 'one small GPU instance'
host.fallback_instance: g4dn.xlarge (1 x T4 16 GB) only if g5 capacity is refused
host.why_gpu: the translator process refuses to run without CUDA (GPU_REQUIRED); neural work never runs on a CPU, and never on the laptop

price_usd_per_hour_on_demand.note: list prices; the controller checks the price page on the day

host.image: an AWS Deep Learning AMI with PyTorch 2.x and CUDA (c45 used ami-0dddfa1ffa6b87af7, PyTorch 2.9, Ubuntu 24.04)
host.self_terminate: shutdown -h +120 set at boot, instance-initiated shutdown behaviour = terminate

deadlines.runner_deadline: kit/run_2r.py stops every stage at min(--deadline-epoch, start + 90 min)

estimate.boot_and_staging_minutes: about 8-12 (payload about 400 MB: weights 230 MB + train rows 91 MB + packages)
estimate.decide_minutes: about 5-10 (retrieval index over 227,497 rows; 8 translator processes on at most about 300 handed-over turns)
estimate.noharm_minutes: about 3-6 (OFF, OFF-removed, ON with three voting processes)
estimate.expected_usd: about 0.35-0.60 on g5 including boot, disk, IPv4 and cleanup
estimate.worst_case_usd: 1.50 (the controller stops at the cap across both attempts)

purpose: CTT-2R rule-only scoring of the c45 weights
start / stop UTC (and Pacific for the owner)
actual cost (list price x host seconds + disk + IPv4; the bill when posted)

cleanup VERIFIED three ways as c45: controller (terminated, volume deleted, deliverable downloaded and verified BEFORE the S3 prefix purge, prefix empty, 0 multipart), an independent read-only check within an hour, a direct read-only look
